MY_HYPOTHESIS_WAS_WRONG: I diagnosed the failure as a contract contradiction -- the contract demanded a test in the same mutation while saying 'emit exactly one operation', which makes adding a function AND its test impossible. I fixed the contradiction and re-ran. Behaviour was IDENTICAL across all three rounds: same reason, same single test-file operation, same NOT_RED_BEFORE. The hypothesis was plausible and it was not the cause.
THE_ACTUAL_CAUSE: The model chose a function that ALREADY EXISTS. Its own summary says 'Added down_proj_scale_overhead_bpw and test file'. That function was added by the accepted G004 unit earlier today, it is present in the module (hasattr True, f(128)=0.041666666666666664), and it appears at line 22 of the very 'complete list of functions that exist right now' the task supplied with the instruction to add one NOT in that list.
SO_THE_LIMIT_IS_TARGET_SELECTION: Given an explicit exclusion list, the resident selected an item FROM the list. It then emitted only the test operation -- correctly, since the function it intended was already there -- and the test passed before the mutation, so red-before-green refused it. Every part of that chain is the model failing to choose a novel target, and every part of the harness behaved correctly.
WHAT_I_KEPT_ANYWAY: The contract contradiction was real even though it was not this failure's cause: 'write the test as part of the same mutation' and 'emit exactly one operation' cannot both be satisfied when the test needs its own file. The clarification stays, recorded as a fix that did NOT change the measured outcome.
AUTONOMY_LADDER_MEASURED_FOR_THIS_RESIDE: exact target + return value -> verified, accepted (G004)
open target, no visibility -> fabricates completion (5 rounds)
open target + module surface -> writes a test for existing behaviour (3 rounds)
open target + surface + explicit exclusion list -> picks an item FROM the list (3 rounds)
READING: Four distinct behaviours, none of them target selection. Adding evidence changes the failure mode each time without producing the capability G009 requires. That is a measured ceiling on this resident, not a harness defect -- and the harness caught every attempt.
